Counter their key spells with Daze, Force of Will, Spell Pierce; burn their blockers and face with Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning; Wasteland their duals. plan_b: Mono-White Death & Taxes: deploy taxing hatebears (Thalia, Mother of Runes, Phyrexian Revoker) and grind on tempo. Lock their mana with Rishadan Port + Wasteland, protect creatures with Mother of Runes, and suit up a threat with Stoneforge Mystic -> Batterskull/Jitte. Swords to Plowshares removes their threats. Attrition and mana-denial win; don't race combo, disrupt it.
